description: Turkish Army Citabria in the Kütahya aircraft park. Construction number 1080-79. Confirmed present on Esri World Imagery examined September 2026, which resolves at least four aircraft on plinths among curving paths in the park.

Second Turkish Army Citabria in the Kütahya park, recorded by spottingmode as displayed as 10104. That marking belongs to another airframe now at the Istanbul Air Force Museum, so tail_number is deliberately blank and the worn marking is given in aliases.
Dakota in the Kütahya aircraft park. Construction number 25970.
Freedom Fighter in the Kütahya aircraft park. Construction number N.7054.
Thunderstreak in the Kütahya aircraft park, wearing the code 385.
Super Sabre in the Kütahya aircraft park, wearing the code 3-724. Construction number 222-16.
Canadair Starfighter in the Kütahya aircraft park, wearing the code 8-841. Construction number 683A-1141. The International F-104 Society records 104841 on a pole at a Kütahya park.
Shooting Star in the Kütahya aircraft park, wearing the code 1-742. Construction number 580-9081.
